newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MOTOR RACING-MALAYSIA TO BUILD FORMULA ONE TRACK.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-MALAYSIA TO BUILD FORMULA ONE TRACK.

text.p: Malaysia on Friday signed an agreement with a German firm to develop a 250 million ringgit ($99.21 million) Formula One racing circuit.

Work on the 5.6-km track, to be built near the country's new international airport outside the capital, will begin early next year and Malaysia hopes to host a round of the Formula One world championship in 1999, officials said.
Malaysia has already agreed to sponsor a Formula One grand prix team led by triple world motor champion Jackie Stewart for 5.12 million pounds sterling ($8.5 million).

At a ceremony on Friday, Malaysia Airports Bhd, which runs the country's airports, signed a consultancy agreement with Tilke Ingenieure Fur Umwelttechnik for design, construction management and commissioning of the track and facilities.
